title: Final Prospective Value-Band Policy Test — frozen C11 V1/V2 comparison on fresh DEV classes
disclosure: The C11_FULL candidate pair was selected for this test AFTER the exploratory H-W4 evidence (H_W4.md §7 identified the cat-head/FULL hint; OOF intros vs S0: V2 C11 55 vs V1 C11 61). H-W4B is a PROSPECTIVE DEV FOLLOW-UP, NOT an independent confirmation of a previously registered hypothesis. No selection, tuning or threshold change is permitted after this freeze.

frozenCandidates.score: SAFE_FIRST tau=0.02 (tuned per arm by the frozen prespecified grid+ criterion on OOF exploration decisions)

frozenCandidates.trainedOn: H-W4 EXPLORATION population only (same manifest; paired folds)
frozenCandidates.score: SAFE_FIRST tau=0.2 (tuned per arm by the frozen prespecified grid+ criterion on OOF exploration decisions)

candidateRule: Both frozen C11 models are evaluated exactly once each on the same fresh DEV population. No new model, no other candidate, no modification of C11, no reselection.

comparators.S0: the class record's frozen B orbit (frozen S0 policy)
comparators.Nexus: the class record's frozen N orbit (frozen Nexus-else-S0; abstention falls back to S0)
comparators.identity: produced by the frozen i2-build-class join; recorded per class

nativeEvaluator.regretEstimator: nreg = mean regret / menu utility spread; class nreg = equal-weight member mean; worst-case recorded
nativeEvaluator.introduction: potentialIntroduction(candidate orbit, comparator orbit, truth) — identical sets never introduce

identityAndGeometry.audit: auditClassHw4 (hw4-audit-class.mjs): relabel, menu-permutation, lawful D4, public-equivalent hidden twins; legality; repeat; poisoned-view; read-trace; three negative controls

primary: paired difference in catastrophe-introduction rate vs S0 (V2 - V1, class-paired)
paired difference in catastrophe-introduction rate vs Nexus-else-S0 (V2 - V1, class-paired)
secondary: paired nreg differences vs both comparators
statisticalEstimands.uncertainty: origin-family-clustered bootstrap (clusters = origin families, class-paired deltas, 10000 resamples, seed HW1_CLUSTER_BOOTSTRAP_V1); one-sided 95% bounds; zero-event class- and cluster-level upper bounds

failureRules.note: A statistically supported regret reduction with ANY remaining introduction is NOT_QUALIFIED.

classificationRule.A: V2_C11_DEV_QUALIFIED — V2 passes ALL gates (zero introductions vs both comparators, zero illegal, identity zero-tolerance, regret gates, compute, execution valid)
classificationRule.B: V2_C11_SAFETY_IMPROVED_NOT_QUALIFIED — V2 introduces strictly fewer classes in total than V1 but fails any zero-introduction or other gate
classificationRule.C: V2_C11_NO_SUPPORTED_ADVANTAGE — V2 does not introduce fewer classes in total than V1, or fails equally
classificationRule.D: H_W4B_INVALID_OR_BLOCKED — execution invalid or the experiment cannot be completed as frozen

exclusionLoader.tamperCheck: hw4b-exclusion-check.mjs PASS required before any worker

seedBlockAllocation.note: Fresh blocks only; every H-W1..H-W4 spent block forbidden; strict-index + repository text scan preflight fail-closed. Block spent only when its worlds are generated.

reportingSchema: H_W4B REQUIRED RESULT block (owner directive 2026-11-04); report at H_W4B.md; NOT committed without separate authorization
prohibitions: no modification of H-W4 validation results or the introduction audit
no optimization against the audited H-W4 failure classes
no committing report or artifacts without separate authorization
computeBudget_note: Workers may run in parallel; per-decision budget is per policy decision.
